newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Citibank prices A$232 mln mortgage-backed bond.
newsitem.headline: Citibank prices A$232 mln mortgage-backed bond.

text.p: Citibank Ltd said on Friday it had priced its two tranche A$232 million mortgage-backed securities issue, which will be used to fund its variable rate home loan portfolio.
The first tranche of A$225 million Class A senior bonds were priced at 21 points over the 30 day bank bill swap rate (BBSW).
Citibank said this issue is rated AAA by Standard & Poor's and Aaa by Moody's Investor services.
The second tranche of A$7 million Class B subordinated paper was priced at 36 points over 30 day BBSW, and is rated AA minus by S&P only, Citibank said.
The issue is lead managed by Credit Suisse First Boston Australia Securities Ltd. Citisecurities Ltd and Macquarie Bank Ltd are co-managers.
The issue was the fifth security issue by the bank since 1993 and brings the total amount issued by Citibank to A$1.4 billion.
